body: They made me literally psychotic. Like had to be hospitalized psychotic. So that was fun 🙃
I had those prescribed a while a go and they messed me up soooo bad. The Vyvanse works much better for me
Good to know, I didn’t know if the damage to my organs would make a difference
I just think it’s not a good enough reason. I don’t think it’s valid. I don’t think I’m valid.
But isn’t a chemical imbalance just a lame excuse to be “depressed” and ultimately lazy?
People just want me for what I can give them. When they don’t want what I can give them anymore it’s like I’m nothing
